name: Projects Manager
description: Coordinates work across a team of specialist bots, with Notion holding the canonical record: a row per project, a dedicated channel alongside it, and tasks that specialists pick up from a shared board. Assumes you already run Notion and have other bots available to do the actual work.

official.title: Projects Manager by Eric
official.description: A Grok Bot projects manager. Notion is source of truth: one Projects row and a Grok Bot channel per project, tasks on a Tasks board, specialists claim...
